parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Unit: milliseconds (UNIX timestamp).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: scopeType
parameters.description:
Filters reports by inspection scope type. Valid values:

- ALL
- TAGS
- DEPLOYMENTS

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Unit: milliseconds (UNIX timestamp).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Filters reports by status. Valid values:

- PENDING
- IN_PROGRESS
- COMPLETED
- FAILED

parameters.name: triggerType
parameters.description:
Filters reports by trigger type. Valid values:

- CRON
- MANUAL
- INNER_API
